criteria_results.requirement: Computed Tomography (CT) of the head or brain is considered medically necessary when specific clinical indications are met. This guideline governs outpatient and elective advanced imaging pre-authorization.
criteria_results.comment: Guidance note; not a binding authorization gate
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 1.0, Page 1
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Explanatory guidance note defining clinical scope for outpatient elective head CT scans.

criteria_results.requirement: Patient must have documented focal or generalized neurological symptoms or signs, including but not limited to severe persistent headaches with atypical features, dizziness, ataxia, or visual disturbances.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.1, Page 1
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Requirement: Documented neurological symptoms or signs (atypical headache, dizziness, ataxia, visual changes).

criteria_results.requirement: For chronic or subacute headache presentations, clinical symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks of active observation or documentation prior to advanced imaging request.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.2, Page 2
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Requirement: Headache symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks prior to imaging authorization.

criteria_results.requirement: A trial of conservative medical management (pharmacological, lifestyle modification, or physical therapy) must have been attempted without symptomatic resolution, unless red flag signs are present.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.3, Page 2
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Requirement: Documented prior trial of conservative therapy (pharmacological, lifestyle, or PT).

criteria_results.requirement: An in-person physical and neurological examination documented by a licensed clinician revealing abnormal or asymmetric findings is mandatory prior to authorization.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.4, Page 3
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Requirement: Documented physical/neurological exam showing abnormal or asymmetric clinical findings.

criteria_results.requirement: The clinical indication must state the requirement to evaluate or rule out intracranial pathology, mass lesion, neoplasm, structural lesion, or acute hydrocephalus.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.5, Page 3
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Requirement: Explicit clinical purpose to rule out serious intracranial pathology, neoplasm, or mass lesion.

criteria_results.requirement: When intravenous contrast (CPT 70460) is requested, explicit diagnostic rationale justifying contrast enhancement (e.g., evaluation of suspected mass, neoplasm, infection, or vascular abnormality) must be provided.
criteria_results.policy_citation: CT Scan of Head / Brain v2026.1, Section 4.2.6, Page 4
criteria_results.plain_english_rationale: Conditional Requirement: If intravenous contrast is requested, clinical rationale must explicitly justify contrast enhancement.

criteria_results.requirement: Documented prior anaphylactic shock or severe unmitigated hypersensitivity to iodinated radiocontrast without prophylactic preparation is a safety contraindication.
